guide.summary: Council found a pending reboot that must finish before further update troubleshooting.
guide.chiefVerdict: Save work, restart cleanly, then rescan After Windows Update before touching services.

councilDiscussion.content: Service restarts are premature while a reboot is still pending from servicing.
councilDiscussion.headline: Reboot first

steps.title: Restart Windows
steps.instructions: Close open apps and restart from the Start menu so Windows can finish pending update configuration.

steps.title: Rescan after reboot
steps.instructions: After login, run the After Windows Update scenario again and compare service findings to this session.
